svg.title: Void Drift ships and equipment artwork
Void Drift — ships and equipment
svg.desc: Exported directly from production drawing routines, 2026-11-05. Five starter ships, five hulls, sixteen engine lighting variants, six equipment items, two utility library items and stabilizer slits. Native vector paths, clips and gradients.

g.text: Production geometry • Editable paths and glass gradients • 05 November 2026
03 / ENGINES — catalogue, left, right, aft lighting
Each asset is one named group. Ungroup to edit faces; use the gradient tool for glass.
Hull / fitted rows share scale. Equipment is enlarged. Labels and background are separate layers.
Solar and repair are library artwork. Corvette retains its current black windows. No raster images.
